semanticsSource: Julius's reported requirements: connected arms, credible grips, no prop/furniture clipping, private cards, cozy Christmas lighting, block props, compact drink ordering and smooth performance

cases.evidence: Actual puff cigar axis [.95056,.01946,.30992] points partly back toward the eyes. Cigar bite [.015,1.335,1.37] and glass rim [.005,1.335,1.365] disagree and float ahead of the authored lips. Anchor-only attachment tests did not detect this.
cases.expected: One shared body lip landmark, outward ember, exact rim/bite contact while held, unchanged arm lengths and no reach correction. Exhalation shares the same landmark.

cases.evidence: Offline measurement of a661198's authored glass pose finds over 20mm penetration despite matching anchors. Applying the shared hero frame unchanged to an opposite-facing opponent fails a production-rig test with 64.829mm detachment at the reach clamp. These are explicitly synthetic measurements of real production geometry, not browser metrics.
cases.expected: Actual skin triangles clear voxel prop envelopes; every supporting digit remains near its surface, with opposing supports. Same grip frame transported by each vessel; all five opponents retain contact and rim/mouth alignment without arm stretching.
cases.candidate: New tests check full triangle projections, not just sampled vertices or bones. Shared hand calibration plus opponent vessel rotation fixes wrong-side reaching. Fresh live trace replays 155 actual hero poses; source/production sip, interruption, cigar and saves checked. Three four-view images preserve the current angular silhouette; not final visual approval.

cases.evidence: All four menu choices recorded in actual source usage. Six exported canvas images include lifted glasses, recessed ashtray and cigar returned to slots. Production menu and busy-state screenshots inspected through CUA. Stack stays 2000 until legal call, not orders.
cases.expected: Self-authored block props, actual recessed tray/rest, one owned glass, no replacement during motion, no chip debit and no abandoned GPU resources.
cases.candidate: Recorded production-mesh replay checks all 772 poses, sole glass, zero reach error and disposal. Asset tests check block triangle orientation, rim/grip bounds, cavity/slot raycasts and actual cigar underside clearance. Gesture surface contact remains in finger-surface-and-grip.

cases.evidence: During attached sip phases the authored hand/glass anchors agree to 4.8e-16m. The visible reach is still wrong: a contact-equality test alone would bless this bug.
cases.expected: Contact constraints AND reachable connected body geometry; both must pass.
cases.candidate: interaction-replay.test.ts preserves the old failure despite equal anchors; interaction-integration.test.ts additionally checks actual sleeve/hand attachment. These do not approve finger surfaces or glass wrap.

cases.evidence: Pause correctly freezes visual time. Inspection cancels directly to homes, without an explicit return phase; cigar request at 39.1742 is rejected during residual inspection blend although the UI button is enabled.
cases.expected: Pause preserves pose; inspection has an explicit safe interruption/return policy and UI availability matches interaction availability.
cases.candidate: Fresh source recording captures mid-sip inspection returning the glass before inspectionReady, with cigar left on tray. Production reproduces return and accepts cigar after Look up. Pause/idempotence and sparse-frame replay pass. D2 publishes resolved availability on transitions: cigar/sip and all replacement choices disable during reach/sip/return; the read-only menu remains accessible.

cases.evidence: Actual pre-batching tree AABB [2.235315,-0.002,-4.375988,4.084685,2.45,-2.524012] intersects recorded bar body, panels, counter and foot rail. Seven block-envelope overlaps. No side/back-wall overlap in this recorded camera/layout; user's broader wall report remains an additional clearance requirement.
cases.expected: Tree including branches/ornaments/presents has positive furniture/wall clearance, verified against production geometry. AABBs are conservative, not proof that every overlapping envelope is a triangle intersection.
cases.candidate: 2026-09-20T04-36-26-293Z records the actual corrected room/decor bounds and seated/wide images. Shared RoomPlan preserves every baseline furniture block; the full tree/presents occupy the clear right bay at 84% scale with >12cm clearance. Garland and wreath also clear all room blocks with >2cm margins. Separate actual-browser-bounds regression ensures the renderer uses the tested plan. Warm lighting and sparse snow were visually checked; controlled performance stays open.

cases.evidence: Front/side/top views show a dark U-shaped slab separated from the rounded jaw. The current beard volume adds a rectangular shell rather than coloring/sculpting the actual facial surface.
cases.expected: Restrained facial hair follows the jaw/upper-lip surface, without floating edges or squared-off cheek growth.
cases.candidate: surface-beard-seat1.png shows short facial hair following the existing jaw from four angles. Surface painting preserves occupied volume and tested area/bounds; production seated capture also shows seats 1 and 4 without the U-shaped plate. Eye/face realism remains unaccepted.

cases.evidence: Finger envelopes look like thin angular ribbons at bends; cigar is balanced across fingers instead of convincingly pinched. Existing no-paper-intersection test is not anatomy/contact signoff. Inspect greedy mesh T-junctions under skinning before adding more volume.
cases.expected: Closed, connected, naturally proportioned finger surfaces through bending; stable visible support/pinch without paper/cigar penetration.
cases.candidate: Actual hand topology regression failed at 1,492 unpaired edges before the fix; conforming voxel faces now have zero unpaired edges through cards/cigar/glass/rest/push poses. Sleeve bends and color seams also pass. topology-player-cards.png and topology-player-cigar.png retain remaining awkward poses/pinch. Each 2.5mm hand has 24,872 vertices/12,436 triangles; each sleeve 32,600/16,300. Performance gate remains open.
